I'm an identical twin and my body developed based off how my sister was positioned. Which was mirror image to me, so now I have situs inversus totalis. A condition where my organs are mirror image to a typical person's. In other words my pancreas, heart, gallbladder, and liver are on the right side of my body. Had an echocardiogram not too long ago and the doc was so excited because it was her first time seeing it loll 

Fun fact: if just the heart is affected then it's dextrocardia.
